events.title: Closed Playtest Has Started!
events.summary: Welcome to the Closed Playtest!The first wave of players has just received access - thanks to everyone who joined in! We’ll keep sending out more invites over the next few days, so stay tuned if you haven’t been picked yet!If you have feedback, questions, or want to share your playthroughs, we’d love to hear from you in our Discord.
